body.condition: \(q_t(x,h)\geq c_mh^\kappa\) for every \(x\in B\), \(t\in\{0,1\}\), and \(0<h\leq h_0\).

novel.justification: Polynomial one-sided depletion occurs when a bivariate score density behaves as \(|r|^{\kappa-2}\) transverse to an eligibility boundary; the normalized flat densities give concrete examples.
